title: Daily Devotional #49
paragraphs: As I read Luke 5, I am struck by the story of Jesus calling his first disciples. It's incredible to think that these men left everything they knew and trusted to follow him. They put their faith in Jesus, without fully understanding who he was or what he would do.

Lord, this story reminds me of the importance of taking risks for you. It's so easy to get comfortable in our everyday lives, but you call us to step out of our comfort zones and trust you. Just like Peter, James, and John, we need to be willing to leave behind our old ways of living and follow you wherever you lead us.

Jesus also teaches us in this chapter about the power of forgiveness. When he heals the paralyzed man, he not only restores his physical health but also forgives his sins. It's a reminder that you are always willing to forgive us, no matter how far we may have strayed from your path.

Lord, as I reflect on this chapter, I pray for the courage to take risks for you and the humility to seek your forgiveness when I fall short. Help me to follow you wholeheartedly, just as Peter, James, and John did.
